title: Surface
description: What is under review, as data: the lines a violation may be reported against, the call sites into and out of them, and what the change leaves unused, dangling, or orphaned across the whole repository. The lines are a selection of the change set: on a first-time review the whole change set, on a subsequent review the changes carrying an unresolved comment, carrying a comment the author resolved since the prior review, or new since the prior review. The call sites are the files that mention a changed file or something its changed lines define, and the files a changed file mentions. The dead-code facts are computed over a snapshot of the head commit, so a probe judges them rather than searches for them. Every file named here travels to the probes; a probe reads nothing else

files.description: The lines a violation may be reported against

CallSites.description: The files around the change that a verdict may need: context a verdict is reached from, never what it is reported against

into.description: Files outside the change set that mention a changed file or a name its changed lines define: the callers

outOf.description: Files outside the change set that a changed file mentions: the callees

DeadCode.description: What the change leaves behind across the whole repository at the head commit, by name: a name is anything the definition patterns recognise, a function, class, type, variable, shell function, or id, and a mention is the name as a whole word in any text file

unusedDefinitions.description: Names the change defines that no file beyond the defining ones mentions

danglingReferences.description: Names whose definition the change removes while files still mention them

orphanedDefinitions.description: Names the change stops mentioning that are now mentioned nowhere beyond the files defining them: definitions the change made dead
